title: An export with no readable session shows a schema mismatch instead of an empty overview
foundBy: session agent, rendering every captured fixture for a gallery the maintainer asked for
details:
When every input file is skipped, the normalizer writes no index, and the export assembler stands in an empty index of its own. That stand-in declares schema version 1, while the viewer implements version 3 and refuses any other (R7). The page then refuses the document, naming the two versions and asking for a re-export with a matching cs-tracer, which sends whoever reads it after the wrong problem. The page that tells the truth shows an overview with no sessions.

Two captured fixtures, `claude/v2.1/all-skipped` and `claude/v2.1/empty-session`, produce this page when exported. R9 says every declaration of the version must agree, and this one is the fifth, written as a literal beside the constant the assembler uses everywhere else.
